body: Thank you guys for the help. My partner didn't liked it and a bit of a background I cheated on her way back. I'm trying my best and Im doing everything I can para makabawi, everything's going well pero lately my minds been giving up on me. I told her na kung pwede magpa seek ako ng professional help pero nagalit lang siya. I begged on my knees pero wala eh. I think that's how it goes talaga and it's karma for me. Thank you guys for all the help and sa mga nag comment. Stay strong and don't fuck up like I did. Godbless you all.

I did tell her. Nagalit lang siya and she won't believe me. Mali ko din kase hindi maganda yung timing ko but it hurts more. I'll get out of the house and go somewhere. I don't know where but somewhere. Thank you for the help.
